sourceInputPolicy: exact newly generated independent fictional paired PNGs only; no original PDF/image and no old literal copying
pairedCondition: same 8 tuples in clear24px and small16px; not independent documents

NDL.confidenceMeaning: native JSON line confidence is detector, never transcription guard replacement
NDL.characterGeometry: unavailable; native line boxes retained, no division by character count

scoring.strictTuple: all original class/day/period/three literal lines correct plus native region containment in semantic bands; cross-cell candidate never split

speedLimitation: different runtimes and cold/warm model lifecycle; timing/RSS descriptive, no engine-only causal superiority claim
